items.title: Engine oil & filter
items.description: Whichever comes first. Check the manual for the interval that applies to your engine.

items.title: Raw-water pump impeller
items.description: Rubber vanes fail without warning and take the engine's cooling with them.

items.title: Lower unit / gear oil
items.description: Milky oil means a failed seal — check the drained oil before refilling.

items.title: Winterize
items.description: Before the first freeze: drain or antifreeze the raw-water side, fog the engine, stabilize the fuel.

items.title: Sacrificial anodes
items.description: Replace at half gone. Sooner in a marina with stray current.

items.title: Bottom paint & hull inspection
items.description: Antifouling, through-hulls, and a look at the running gear while it is out.

items.title: Safety gear check
items.description: Fire extinguisher gauge, flare expiry dates, life jacket condition.

items.title: Registration renewal
items.description: Annual in most places; some states register for two or three years.
